answer: The mesa lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the ember is where a second reviewer recomputes them. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. What survives to the atlas is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, taxed when attestations come from one subnet, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short.
